title: Down into Vicrium
journal: Nesh-Deeka knew the mark on the knight-captain's disc: Vicrium, an old mine behind Seafalls, where the knights kept a strongbox. I should go there and ask at the mine; Ah-Zish is its gallery-boss.
objectives: Ask Ah-Zish, the gallery-boss of Vicrium, about the knights' strongbox. (marker: Ah-Zish)

plan.going: The disc points to Vicrium, where the knights kept a strongbox.
plan.next: Go by boat to Seafalls and up the road to Vicrium, and ask the gallery-boss, Ah-Zish.

answers: I am Tarin, a thief of Nesh-Deeka house. The knight-captain disc carries a pick-and-tower mark that Nesh-Deeka says is Vicrium, an old mine, where the knights kept a strongbox. It is on the trail to the Eye of Argonia, and the Unbound are ahead of us.
Ask Ah-Zish, the gallery-boss here at Vicrium, about the knights strongbox.
I can talk to Ah-Zish, or try the locked door to the Lower Galleries (needs a pick or key), or the Old Lower Adit. There is also a Crocodile here.

I do not understand why the Unbound seal trees with paralysis paste, or who the "we" is that listens. Cuts-the-Old-Knot, Xeech-Leel, Umbriel and Ennodius Vanin are unknown. I could ask people along the way.

title: Down into Vicrium
journal: Ah-Zish shut the lower galleries behind a locked timber door after a roof fall, and keeps its key on his belt; the door cannot be picked. He hears voices below, smugglers, he thinks, come in by the old adit on the creek bank, which is flooded and full of crocodiles. He might give me the key for good words or a hundred gold, or I could lift it from him; if he catches me at it, he shouts for his miners. Past the door I need to find the knights' strongbox, and the smugglers down there will attack anyone they see.
objectives: Get the key to the lower galleries from Ah-Zish. (marker: Ah-Zish)
Search the knights' strongbox in the lower galleries. (marker: Knights' Strongbox)

plan.going: The knights' strongbox is in Vicrium's lower galleries, shut behind a timber door whose key Ah-Zish carries. Smugglers have moved in below.
plan.next: Get the key from Ah-Zish, go through the timber door and find the strongbox.
plan.ways: Persuade Ah-Zish, pay him 100 gold or pick his pocket; or find the old adit on the creek bank and swim in past the crocodiles. Below, fight the smugglers or sneak past them.

answers: Ah-Zish locked the lower galleries after a roof fall and hears voices below, likely smugglers coming by the flooded crocodile adit. The knights strongbox is down there.
Get the key from Ah-Zish, then find the strongbox in the lower galleries.
Persuade him, pay 100 gold, pickpocket the key (risk: he shouts for miners), or try the flooded adit with crocodiles. The door cannot be picked.
Nothing new that I do not understand, except who the smugglers are, maybe Unbound; I will find out below.

title: Down into Vicrium
journal: In the knights' strongbox lay an old parchment map: seven towers standing in the sea, and a crag shaped like a tooth on an island. Nesh-Deeka will want it in Helstrom.
objectives: Bring the parchment map to Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom. (marker: Nesh-Deeka)

plan.going: I have a map of seven sea towers and a tooth-shaped crag. The hunt's aim: find the Eye of Argonia, the old kings' jewel that can heal every tree, at the Root, where all the trees' roots meet under the sea, before the Unbound do.

answers: I got into the lower galleries of Vicrium with a key lifted from Ah-Zish, killed a smuggler, and found an old parchment map in the knights strongbox: seven towers in the sea and a tooth-shaped crag on an island. It is probably a lead toward the Eye of Argonia.
Bring the map to Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom.
Go straight back to Helstrom, or look at the map and explore more first. I could also read the map before leaving.
I do not know what the seven towers or the tooth crag are, or who the smugglers worked for (maybe the Unbound). Nesh-Deeka or the map itself may tell me.
raw: 1. I got into the lower galleries of Vicrium with a key lifted from Ah-Zish, killed a smuggler, and found an old parchment map in the knights strongbox: seven towers in the sea and a tooth-shaped crag on an island. It is probably a lead toward the Eye of Argonia. 2. Bring the map to Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom. 3. Go straight back to Helstrom, or look at the map and explore more first. I could also read the map before leaving. 4. I do not know what the seven towers or the tooth crag are, or who the smugglers worked for (maybe the Unbound). Nesh-Deeka or the map itself may tell me.

title: Down into Vicrium
journal: Nesh-Deeka already knew the Unbound had not reached Vicrium, and did not say how. She named me Toh-Wo, "Secret-Speaker", the order's second rank, with 200 gold, and offered me the order's gift: a rapier or a quarterstaff.
objectives: Choose a rapier or a quarterstaff from Nesh-Deeka. (marker: Nesh-Deeka)

plan.going: I am a Toh-Wo now. Nesh-Deeka again knew where the Unbound had not been and would not say how. The hunt's aim: find the Eye of Argonia, the old kings' jewel that can heal every tree, at the Root, where all the trees' roots meet under the sea, before the Unbound do.
terms: Toh-Wo: Nesh-Deeka: "Secret-Speaker", the order's second rank

answers: I gave Nesh-Deeka the map. She said the Unbound had not reached Vicrium, without saying how she knew. She promoted me to Toh-Wo, Secret-Speaker, second rank, paid 200 gold and offered the orders weapon.
Choose a rapier or a quarterstaff from Nesh-Deeka, here in her house in Helstrom.
Rapier or quarterstaff. As a thief I favour the rapier, light and quick.
I still do not know who "we" is in "we listen", what the seven towers and tooth crag mean (her officer is to read them), or the four unknown names. I could ask her how she knows.

title: Down into Vicrium
journal: I took the rapier. Nesh-Deeka passed me to her officer, Never-Writes-Twice, who stands at the back of the same room; from now on I report to her. She wants to see the map.
objectives: Show the map to Never-Writes-Twice in Nesh-Deeka's House. (marker: Never-Writes-Twice)

plan.going: I now answer to Never-Writes-Twice, the order's officer. The hunt's aim: find the Eye of Argonia, the old kings' jewel that can heal every tree, at the Root, where all the trees' roots meet under the sea, before the Unbound do.
plan.next: Show her the map, at the back of the room.
terms: Never-Writes-Twice: Nesh-Deeka: her officer, to whom the player now reports

answers: I took the rapier. Nesh-Deeka answered how she knew only with "We listen". She now passes me to her officer Never-Writes-Twice, who wants to see the map.
Show the map to Never-Writes-Twice, at the back of this same room.
Just talk to her; I could also ask Nesh-Deeka what Toh-Wo means.
Still unknown: who "we" are who listen, what the seven towers and tooth crag are, and the names Cuts-the-Old-Knot, Xeech-Leel, Umbriel, Ennodius Vanin. Never-Writes-Twice may read the map for me.

title: Down into Vicrium
journal: Never-Writes-Twice knew the crag on the map: the Grey Tooth, the seamark of Skeith Isle. She told me Cuts-the-Old-Knot was once one of the order, who went mad on sap and killed her minders. She marked the Grey Tooth.

plan.going: The map leads to the Grey Tooth on Skeith Isle. Never-Writes-Twice says Cuts-the-Old-Knot was one of the order gone mad on sap. The hunt's aim: find the Eye of Argonia, the old kings' jewel that can heal every tree, at the Root, where all the trees' roots meet under the sea, before the Unbound do.
plan.next: MN11 starts; its first entry marks the Grey Tooth.
terms: the Grey Tooth and Skeith Isle: Never-Writes-Twice: a crag that is the seamark of Skeith Isle

answers: The Vicrium quest is done. The map shows the Grey Tooth, seamark of Skeith Isle, reached by boat to Archon and Arorha. Never-Writes-Twice marked it, and warned me that Cuts-the-Old-Knot was once of the order, went mad on sap, killed her minders, and I should not listen to her.
Nothing is set yet; the next step is presumably to go to Skeith Isle via Archon and Arorha.
Ask Never-Writes-Twice more, or head for the boat to Archon/Arorha.
Unknown still: who "we" are who listen, why the Unbound seal trees with paralysis paste, Xeech-Leel, Umbriel, Ennodius Vanin, and the seven towers meaning.
